reference_identity.solver: tools/mechanism_factory/patch_equilibrium.py:solve_equilibrium (monotone backtracking projected descent; five named terminal states)
reference_identity.fixtures: tools/membrane_scale_lab/fixture_generator.py:high_degree_fan (apex-cone variants; see exclusions for why loaded irregular_patch is excluded)

verifier_identity.receipt_adapter: tools/mechanism_factory/receipt_adapter.py (accepted schema chimera-mechanism-factory-qualification-receipt-v2; v1 receipts are refused explicitly as receipt_schema_unsupported)

inputs.fixed_vertices: list[int], pinned to zero displacement (full rim only)
inputs.loads: list[(vertex_index,(fx,fy,fz))] dead loads [N]; refused on pinned vertices; vertical-only on the free apex

outputs.free_residual: float |P.F_total| max over free DOFs [wu] (displacement-scale stationarity residual)

normalization.world_unit: 1 wu = 1 m (never redefined); gamma in J/wu^2 makes energy J and reactions J/wu = N exact SI
normalization.energy_origin: U(x) = sum gamma_t A_t(x) - sum f_i . x_i
normalization.residual_note: free_residual is the displacement-scale residual max_free |P.F_total| in wu (== m); it is NOT a Newton quantity; reactions are Newtons
normalization.status_semantics: 'stationary' (residual <= 1e-12*mean_edge) is reachable only from exactly-stationary starts (zero-load flat meshes); loaded solves legitimately terminate as 'stagnated' at the machine-scale floor -- see patch_equilibrium_checks.py C3/C6

exclusions: loads on pinned vertices (solver refuses them)

partial-rim pin sets: a FREE rim vertex is not force-free under the constant-gamma current-area law (film contracts its free edge) -- no equilibrium exists (patch_equilibrium_checks.py C3 FIXTURE NOTE / C6 honesty witness)

loaded irregular_patch variants: soft tangential (reparametrization) modes, Hessian condition ~1e7, the lab's fixed preconditioner P=1/gamma_max cannot descend them (same C3 finding, verified in-place)
tangential (in-plane) load components on the free apex: they excite the same soft modes; vertical loads only
degenerate or negatively oriented triangles (fixture validator refuses)

size_vs_resolution_axes.physical_size_axis: cone radius in m (admitted 0.5-2.0 m at unit gamma; wu = 1 m)
size_vs_resolution_axes.resolution_axis: n_rim at fixed radius (admitted 200-240; apex is the single free vertex)
size_vs_resolution_axes.scale_mapping_validity: valid because the descent preconditioner P = 1/gamma_max is dimensionally exact [wu^2/J] and wu = 1 m maps energies to J and reactions to N without rescaling; the step guard GUARD_FRAC*min_edge scales with rim spacing, so convergence step count grows with resolution -- budgeted, not rescaled

negative_controls: a load on a pinned vertex must be refused by the solver (LOAD_ON_FIXED_VERTEX; no solve performed)
a zero-load flat regular disk is exactly stationary at start: status 'stationary' with free_residual <= 1e-15 wu (documents the 'stationary' terminal state)
reaction sum + applied load sum must vanish componentwise within max_force_balance_residual (pins carry all loads)
no overwrite of an existing evidence file (resolve_evidence_path refusal, exit 2)

acceptance_thresholds.max_free_residual_N_justification: free_residual is the displacement-scale residual |P.F| [wu==m]. The binding floor is the solver's own machine-scale stagnation floor, decrease <= eps*max(|U|,1) with P=1 and |U| <= ~5 J, giving an achievable residual of ~sqrt(2*eps*|U|*P) ~ 3e-8; 1e-6 is ~30x that expected floor and equals the registered falsifier battery's own preregistered C3 balance tolerance (1e-6*max(1,sum|f|)). Set before any receipt run; the earlier 1e-12 draft mispredicted the binding floor (the residual gate 1e-12*mean_edge is unreachable for loaded solves under this law).
acceptance_thresholds.max_force_balance_residual_justification: net external force on a body in static equilibrium is exactly zero (sum reactions + sum loads = 0 by the law's translation invariance); the numeric floor is the same machine-scale stagnation residual ~3e-8 N for ~1 N loads; 1e-6 N is ~30x that and matches the battery's C3 tolerance. Set before any receipt run.
acceptance_thresholds.max_moment_balance_residual_justificatio: net external moment about the origin vanishes for a supported body in equilibrium (the law's torque invariance, origin-independent per C3); expected residual ~ max lever arm (<= 1.5 wu) x force floor (3e-8 N) ~ 5e-8 N.m; 1e-6 N.m is ~20x that and matches the battery's C3 moment tolerance (1e-6*max(1,sum|x||f|)). Set before any receipt run.

checkpoint_policy: none: single-pass CPU runs, seconds-scale; the stamped evidence receipt is the only artifact and is never silently overwritten
fallback: if any case returns a disallowed terminal state or violates a threshold, halve that case's load magnitude (smaller sag travel, same physics) and retry once; if it still fails, exit 1 naming the case_id
stopping_conditions: all 3 cases terminate with status in {stationary, stagnated} (stagnated = documented machine-scale floor for loaded solves; 'stationary' alone is only reachable from exactly-stationary starts) AND all packet thresholds hold -> exit 0, receipt written
any case status is step_limit/no_descent_step/invalid_surface, or any threshold is violated -> exit 1 with the failing case_id
evidence target path already exists and no --force-out -> exit 2 (evidence never silently overwritten)
